scope: Unbounded role identities and abstract original SET/inheritance reachability predicates. Inheritance and SET are distinct; excluding selected unsafe roles over complete SET reachability prevents the modeled bypass. Later membership changes have countermodels; stable reachability preserves the exclusion.
limitations: No PostgreSQL pg_has_role SET/transitive-closure or SQL/Python refinement proof
Role/ACL lifetime, complete privileged-role/routine inventory and qualified-definer profiles remain unqualified
No authenticated caller/issuer, full authority admission or protected final release proof
